dpn_reciprocity.definition: The pressure to return a favour that the other side has given you.
dpn_reciprocity.example: The discount was the favour, and the renewal at the same price was the bill.

exacerbation.definition: A period when the symptoms get noticeably worse than their usual level.
exacerbation.example: The main exacerbation lasted about four days last month.

gd_denial.definition: The refusal to accept a shared account, said in a way that does not change when the evidence appears.
gd_denial.example: The denial was said the same way every time, and the message did not change it.

hi.definition: A short and casual way to say hello, used with people you already know.

panel_serving_size.definition: The amount of the product the nutrition figures are given for. It is the maker's choice, so it often does not match what you eat.
panel_serving_size.example: One serving is 30 g, which is much less than the bowl I had.

si_symbol.definition: A written sign that stands for a quantity or an idea.
si_symbol.example: Read the symbol, then the English name.
